editorial.author: Claude Code (AI draft) for PMH developer
editorial.medicalReviewer: ชื่อ นามสกุล (ตำแหน่ง)
reviewNotes: Narration derived only from lesson MCH68-ASSESS-003 v0.1.0; no new content.
Thai-speaking reviewer: check pronunciation of แอลกอฮอล์, สาโท, กะแช่, วิสกี้, สปาย, บุหรี่ไฟฟ้า.

AWARENESS-ONLY CHECK used because it is central to this assessment lesson: the video says staff assess drinking, smoking or e-cigarettes and close contacts who smoke at the first ANC visit (p8, staff-only checklist). No item numbers, colour codes or risk levels; 'ใช้สารเสพติด' left out. Reviewer to confirm, or remove stage 3 item 6.
AWARENESS-ONLY CHECK: the p19 alcohol question is described only in general terms ('ถ้าเคยดื่ม ควรได้รับการประเมินและการดูแลเพิ่มเติม'). No screening items or scores. Reviewer to confirm.
'ตอบตามจริง' is app framing from the lesson (not printed in the handbook).

SCOPE NOTE (lesson): the handbook says nothing about smoking while breastfeeding or second-hand-smoke harms; the video applies the breastfeeding rule to alcohol only and the smoking harm to pregnancy only.
Lesson note applies: PMH smoking-cessation and alcohol-counselling contacts should be shown with this lesson (not in the narration).
